messages:
mika: Heads up — starting intake for sparrow-8k-quant (8k context, int8/ptq candidate). Want to align on priority, smoke tests, and staged rollout plan for hosted + dedicated. :seedling:
raj: SGTM. What are the top workloads we care about? embeddings, chat, or long-form generation?
olivia: Primary: multi-turn assistant (chat) with long context; secondary: retrieval augmentation + rerank. Latency sensitivity is medium for chat, high for embeddings.
mika: OK. Initial hypothesis: int8 PTQ gives 1.8x token throughput vs fp16 on the same GPU, p99 latency +15ms. Need to validate quality on our regression suites.
jamie: Can we run the usual eval battery (lm eval + convo eval + rerank holdouts)? I’ll queue the evals today.
kev: Add a long-context mem/caching smoke: KV cache correctness across >8k windows. I’ve seen int quant annoyances there.
mika: Good call. Also need to run perf profile with realistic batching: 8/16/32 batch sizes, and streaming latency.
raj: For rollout, propose staged rings: ring-0 internal (dev org only), ring-1 low-traffic hosted (1% traffic), ring-2 dedicated customers on test capacity, ring-3 ramp to 50% then 100% with automatic rollback.
olivia: For private/on-prem we should provide a guarded build only after ring-2 pass. Private deploys need KMS validation and audit logs.
mika: Below is a minimal rollout config I want to test in deploy pipeline. Please review before I add to infra repo:
```
rollout:
  model: sparrow-8k-quant-int8-v1
  rings:
    - name: ring-0
      traffic: 0.0
      scope: internal
      checks: [smoke, kv-correctness]
    - name: ring-1
      traffic: 0.01
      scope: hosted
      checks: [latency-p95, quality-regressions]
    - name: ring-2
      traffic: 0.10
      scope: dedicated-test
      checks: [throughput, cost-estimate]
    - name: ring-3
      traffic: 1.0
      scope: prod
      checks: [slo-monitoring, fallback]
  fallback_model: raven-13b-fp16
  auto_rollback: true
  rollback_criteria: [p99>2s, quality-drop>3%]
```
jamie: Looks good. For quality-drop metric, define specific evals and thresholds per workload — e.g., convo-bleu drop >2% OR rerank-ndcg drop >1.5% triggers.
kev: Observability checklist: add token-level cost, per-token latency histogram, KV hit ratio, generation divergence rate (compared to baseline), and error rate (decode failures).
raj: Also add a synthetic adversarial prompt set to catch truncation/ hallucination regressions under quantization.
mika: On testing infra: can we run a mixed-quant experiment (int4 for attention + int8 for FFN) as an A/B in ring-1? Might be risky but worth a quick microbenchmark.
jamie: We can schedule as a performance-only variant (no user-facing traffic) first. If perf looks great, include in ring-2 AB test with shadow traffic.
olivia: Deployment modes notes: hosted — fast rollback and routing; dedicated — slower because of capacity commitments; private — requires customer consent window and migration docs. We need separate runbooks per mode.
mika: Runbook bullets I want in the PR: preflight (eval pass + kv smoke), rollout matrix (rings + percent), monitoring (dashboards + alerts), fallback procedure (manual + auto), postmortem triggers.
kev: Suggested alert thresholds: p95 > 800ms, p99 > 2s, quality-drop flag from eval pipeline, decode-exceptions > 0.1%.
raj: Security check: quantized artifacts must be signed; provide SBOM for private. Add a config check in CI.
mika: Who volunteers to own the ring-0 -> ring-1 promotion steps? I can own ring-0 and ring-1 promotion if SRE helps with canary infra.
kev: SRE will monitor and handle routing changes. I’ll add a short Playbook doc in eng-sre.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: new deploy ticket created: DPL-2398 (sparrow-8k-quant-intake). Link: https://redwood/deploy/DPL-2398 :white_check_mark:
mika: Great. Action items: jamie — run eval battery (ETA 24h). kev — KV + perf smoke (ETA 24h). raj — draft rollout PR with the YAML snippets (ETA 48h). olivia — prepare private deployment checklist (ETA 72h). I’ll coordinate ring promotions.
jamie: Starting evals now. Will post results in this thread.
kev: Running KV smoke. Will attach logs.
mika: Thanks all. If anyone finds a >1.5% quality regression on core convos, hold rollout and escalate.
jamie: quick update — LM evals done: perplexity diff +0.6%, convo quality metric -0.8% (within threshold). Sending artifacts.
kev: KV smoke passed on 8k sequences, but noticed rare off-by-one token in batched decode when batch_size=32 — filing bug (ML-4489).
mika: Put blocker: ML-4489 must be fixed or ring-1 blocked.
raj: Noted. I’ll keep ring-1 at 0% until ML-4489 fixes.
mika: Closing for now — will reopen when bug resolved. Thanks. :seedling:
